q4_trailing_basis.construction_identity: Use actual selected QUARTER construction IDs, not source-period IDs as construction IDs.

fy_and_q4_identity.rule: Historical FY, historical Q4/display basis and rolling four-quarter basis remain distinct even when end date, column_key or numeric result agrees. No duplicate chronological point or duplicate maturity exposure from FY+Q4.

current_maturity_wall.rule: Current outstanding exposure assigned to contractual final maturity; not a projection of balance at2029.

lineage_and_rendering.numeric_marks: Reference selected authentic source/computation/metric records; monetary amounts retain currency/scale and basis identity.
lineage_and_rendering.missing_marks: value=null and explanatory G# reference; never zero.
lineage_and_rendering.table_twin: Exact same final cell texts and mark order as ChartSpec; display.format_value governs spelling.
lineage_and_rendering.canonical_model: Report and canonical Model must consume the same selected current run and agree on serialized series values/units/bases/references; chart integration is an implementation obligation, not a source gap.

adversarial_cases.expected: Q1-Q3 leverage and interest cover stay null with gap references; no interpolation, zero, forward FY use or quarterly annualization.
Zero/negative EBITDA or a nonpositive cash-interest denominator refuses a numeric ratio under adopted metric rules; missing input stays unavailable. No infinity or zero substitute.
Explicit RCF commitment0 and drawn0 produce numeric undrawn0. Missing either required input cannot be replaced by zero.
Never treat term-loan commitment less drawn as undrawn RCF. Q1 liquidity remains16.25, not20.
Current maturity balance is50, never100; FY and Q4 are distinct period identities sharing one closing facility snapshot.
Missing contractual maturity or incomplete facility population must remain a disclosed gap; never invent a date or claim a complete maturity wall.
Reject or explicitly disclose unsupported currency/scale mismatch; USD50million is USD50000000, notUSD50 or USD50000000000000.
Wrong/foreign/missing source, computation, metric operand or construction reference must fail the applicable validation; same-valued FY and Q4 ratios do not establish equivalent lineage.
Refuse current-result qualification for stale/foreign producer bindings or tampered serialized chart values; canonical Model and rendered report must agree with the same selected run.
Existing genuine gap case remains CONDITIONAL/DO NOT RUN; actual CP1 admission and publisher refuse, with no CP1/Model head or Model files. No chart zero-fill.

Minimal expected wall contains only2029 maturity50; no forecast balances or unsourced zero-filled years. Any additional empty bins require an explicit snapshot-completeness interpretation and clear nonforecast labeling.
Chart availability cannot upgrade restricted CP0/CP1/Model or QA58/Restricted/Low, establish another analytical owner, or remove original limitations.
